description: Additive oscillator — up to 100 sine partials summed

params.text: Sets the pitch, -3 to +6 volts; 0V is C4 at 261.63Hz
The spacing of the partials in frequency; at noon each partial is an octave above the one before
Moves the odd-numbered partials off the spacing set by WIDTH, up or down
Moves the even-numbered partials off the spacing set by WIDTH, up or down
The output level, by way of an internal amplitude normalisation
Tilts the amplitudes of the partials; at noon they fall off in proportion to frequency, and either side of that the fall is steeper or shallower
Cuts the amplitudes of the odd partials, or of the even ones
Reshapes the partial amplitudes the way a low-pass or a high-pass filter would
Runs the partials as sines or as cosines
Trims the pitch by a semitone either way

inputs.text: Pitch at a volt per octave, clamped to 5V either way and added to the frequency knob; the channels patched here set the polyphony
A rising edge restarts the oscillator at the beginning of its cycle
A 0-10V CV attenuating the partial count set by the knob
A bipolar CV, -5 to +5V, added to the partial spacing
A bipolar CV, -5 to +5V, added to the odd-partial skew
A bipolar CV, -5 to +5V, added to the even-partial skew
A bipolar CV, -5 to +5V, added to the gain
A bipolar CV, -5 to +5V, added to the amplitude tilt
A bipolar CV, -5 to +5V, added to the odd and even balance
A bipolar CV, -5 to +5V, added to the filter shaping
